mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100 (the 2017 base index), it indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior month signals strengthening labor conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% and UNRATE declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
